body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Madame Tussauds London, Marylebone Rd, London NW1 5LR, UK. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Madame Tussauds. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Welcome to this self-guided audio tour of London, a journey that will take you through some of the city's most iconic and historically significant landmarks. This tour is perfect for anyone interested in history, culture, and architecture.
>
> Your tour begins at Madame Tussauds London, a world-famous wax museum located on Marylebone Road, where your ticket is included. However, please note that an audio tour inside Madame Tussauds is not provided. From there, you will make your way through a series of notable sites, including the Royal Academy of Music, the Sherlock Holmes Museum, Trafalgar Square, and many other famous attractions. The tour concludes at Big Ben, one of the most recognizable landmarks in the world, situated adjacent to the Palace of Westminster.
>
> Along the way, you will discover the rich history and cultural significance of each location. You will see the elegant architecture of the Royal Academy of Music, immerse yourself in the Victorian world of the Sherlock Holmes Museum, and experience the vibrant atmosphere of Trafalgar Square. The tour will also take you to other iconic sites such as the National Gallery, Horse Guards Parade, and Westminster Abbey, each offering a unique perspective on London's diverse heritage.
>
> This tour promises to be an unforgettable experience, allowing you to walk at your own pace and hear every word of the tour without interruption.
